text:
Dear Harbor Logistics team,

I am excited to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer position at Harbor Logistics. With eight years of experience building reliable backend systems specifically for marketplaces and logistics, I am eager to bring my expertise in Go, PostgreSQL, and distributed systems to your team.

In my current role, I have taken ownership of our shipment tracking platform, developing a set of Go services that ingest carrier events through Kafka and reconcile them with PostgreSQL data. This setup has allowed us to provide a real-time API that serves forty thousand merchants. I successfully led the migration from a monolith to an event-driven architecture without any downtime, which speaks to my ability to manage complex projects in a fast-paced environment.

A key aspect of my work has been improving performance and reliability. I introduced idempotent consumers to prevent issues with duplicated deliveries and achieved a remarkable reduction in p99 latency of our tracking API from 900 milliseconds to just 120 milliseconds. Additionally, I take pride in having established observability practices within my team, setting up tracing and SLO dashboards to enhance our operational insights.

Mentoring mid-level engineers and contributing to architecture decision records are also vital parts of my role. I value clear written communication and believe in incorporating operational considerations into the product. I look forward to leveraging this approach at Harbor Logistics, especially as I aim to tackle routing and warehouse systems at a larger scale.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to your team and help advance Harbor Logistics' mission.

Sincerely,
